description: The files kept as a project's references, newest first: each with its sourceId, every version (file name, type, size, sha256, when and how it was given, the note given with it, whether its words were read) and knowledgeId, the knowledge entry holding its words (read_knowledge). sourcesUrl is the project's Sources page.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

title: List a project's reference files
